macros.name: byline
macros.doc: When writing an editorial or if you just want to add a by-line, use the \byline command.

macros.name: closearticle
macros.doc: The \closearticle command is used to show the end of an article.

macros.name: headline
macros.doc: The \headline{⟨text⟩} command is used to set the headline of the article.
